newsitem.title: USA: Champion Enterprises stock falls after earnings warning.
newsitem.headline: Champion Enterprises stock falls after earnings warning.

text.p: Champion Enterprises Inc. stock fell sharply Friday after the maker of mobile homes said its second-quarter earnings could fall below last year's levels.

Champion shares lost $1 to $14.75 on the New York Stock Exchange after Chief Executive Walter Young Jr. said Thursday that difficult market conditions and higher operating costs could result in quarterly earnings below last year's 39 cents a share.
Young also predicted sluggish growth for the entire industry this year, which could impact earnings in future quarters.
Champion, based in Auburn Hills, Mich., had revenues of $1.6 billion last year, tops in the industry.
